fact: Actualite.cd reported on 23 November 2024 that ANICNS had equipped the Muya, Banzola and Kabeya Kamwanga hospitals in Mbuji-Mayi, the Kalemie general referral hospital and the Mutowa health centre in Tanganyika with computers, tablets and routers to put into service an ANICNS-approved hospital information system and ease portability of the computerised patient record, in a project financed entirely by the Congolese government.
title: RDC : l’ANICNS dote les hôpitaux de Mbuji-Mayi et Kalemie d’équipements numériques pour leur transformation digitale
